questions, objections, alternatives, and named decisions are durable
milestones, interfaces, budgets, risks, evidence gates, and owners are explicit

readiness observations and blockers are recorded; no physical readiness or command is claimed
design, simulation, provenance, readiness gaps, and open risks are inspectable
